name: Apollo 7
about: Apollo 7 (1968-089A), a crewed vehicle (Apollo II), launched 1968 Oct 11. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1968 Oct 13), held fixed
GCAT names the site (-) without coordinates; the point is a stand-in
